name: Goblin Quarry
_design: Third fight arena (Boss 2026-10-14: a goblin quarry, same 28 x 21 m as the other two). A worked-out stone pit the goblins squat in: grey cut floor streaked with ochre water stains, stepped rock benches outside the walkable box and a high cut face across the north with two ramps hacked through it - the exit portals stand on the ramps, flagged by skull posts and red rags. Landmark: the quarry winch, a timber A-frame with a cracked boulder hanging in a rope net and a brazier at its foot, dead centre on the north face; a rusty rail line runs from the north-east ramp across the pit to a parked ore cart, so the eye always knows which way the pit works. Cover is cut stone: four blocks spread wide, a spoil heap east and a tipped ore cart north-west; the middle stays open for the knight (sixth spot) to march into. Glow mushrooms in the wall shade and a small fire south-west give the night its warm and cold lights. Built by tools/blender/build_goblin_stages.py (art and this file come from one layout; edit the script, not this file).
